errors.evidence: This final sentence is meta-commentary about the description itself ('Without making interpretations...') and adds no factual information about the plot's content.
The confidence line starts at a value of approximately 0.73 on the y-axis, making 0.7 a slight underestimation.
The confidence line ends at a value of approximately 0.82 on the y-axis, not 0.85. The description overstates the final value.
The alignment line ends at a value of approximately 0.28 on the y-axis, not 0.25. The description understates the final value.
